title: Compose and publish Lessig on Remix Big Beat score
description: Compose and publish a Big Beat score revolving around Lessig speech cuts, building rhythmic tension from speech fragments before opening into full phrase and heavy drop.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Composed and measured Lessig on Remix Big Beat score (126 BPM, Em) built around Colbert-and-Lessig-on-REMIX_18701.mp3 speech chops. Speech syllables teased as syncopated transients before full statement entrance. Measured objective_v2 102.58 with no suggestions and no v2 guard failures. Published to cloud storage as scr_scores_Lessig on Remix_apr.

right_now_summary: The Lessig Big Beat score is composed, measured, and published to cloud storage.
